text:
omar: quick heads-up — new model bring-up (redwood-bridge-v2, q4f) showed a weird drop on short instruction prompts, ~6% accuracy delta vs baseline on the promptset we use for UI snippets. can curation / label-ops triage?
rachel: on it. can you paste the failing prompt examples? rough counts?
omar: 20 failing samples in the short-instr partition, attached to the run: `s3://redwood-bridge/runs/2026-03-21/bridge-v2-q4f/failures.json` — mostly 1-2 sentence instructions + single-token answers. metric is exact-match after normalization.
sam: thanks. two quick asks: 1) are these true model regressions or tokenization / detokenization mismatch because of quant path? 2) did we hit a new tokenizer version on this run?
omar: tokenizer is stable (tokenizer v14). quant path is different: q4f with our new kernel set. eval-bot: automated regression check finished: baseline=0.87, bridge-v2-q4f=0.81, p=0.003. breakdown attached in the run.
jen: label-ops here. we can re-run the dedupe and a small relabel batch for the 20 samples. want to confirm label schema (short-instr -> single-label answer) and golden status. do we want to promote any of these to golden?
rachel: hold off on promoting until we confirm repro. first we should expand sample window to +200 near-neighbors (semantic neighbors) to check fragility. if the regression is narrow, it's probably model brittle behavior, not labeling.
sam: agree. I'll run a targeted eval with 10k prefixes sampled from production prefix distribution but restricted to short length and single-turn. command i'll run:
```
python -m eval.harness --model redwood-bridge-v2-q4f --dataset short-instr-candidate --limit 10000 --metric exact_match --save debug/bridge-v2-q4f-short.json
```
lee: deferring the golden decision. also flagging possible promptset leakage: some of those failing items were introduced during last seedbank merge (mar 2026) — might be duplicates with recent production examples. run a fuzzy-dedupe on the 200 neighbors, threshold 0.82 cosine.
jen: we can do that. i'll queue a dedupe job and a micro-batch of 100 samples for manual relabeling. ETA 4 hours.
katie: FYI — product is watching because snippets feature A/B uses short-instr set. if this holds we might need a canary rollback. keep me posted.
omar: thanks. sam — can you also try running an int8 fallback (same model arch) to see if regression is quant-specific?
sam: yeah will do int8 fallback + float16 baseline. i'll post a quick diff by EOD.
rachel: process note: once sam posts diffs we will 1) run fuzzy dedupe 2) sample 200 near-neighbors 3) land a 100-sample golden relabel if inconclusive, 4) open a short PR to update the golden if label-ops confirms.
eval-bot: quick results: int8_fallback v float16_baseline on short-instr (n=10k) -> int8_fallback=0.86, float16=0.87, q4f=0.81 (same run families). seems q4f kernel path is the outlier.
jen: ok that's actionable. i'll prioritize the relabeling batch for tonight and mark the 20 failures as "investigate" in labelboard.
sam: filing a runtime bug with eng-runtime for the q4f kernel path, assigning to @lee-runtime. ticket: INF-2026-118.
lee: ack, will triage. can you include the debug run output and a small repro snippet? i.e. the seed + prompt + model config.
omar: logging the repro in the run bucket now. thanks team.
rachel: once we have dedupe output i'll post the de-dup summary and proposed golden candidates here. trying to avoid promoting noisy items. :thumbsup:
